description: Full-episode joint update-interval sweep with unchanged J6/N512/H3/B512 collection: intervals 512, 256, and 128, plus interval 128 with half actor learning rate, mirrored for inner and frozen outer target Q. Automatic-temperature updates follow every actor update.

interval_budget.description: Four joint update-interval/actor-learning-rate settings for each bootstrap source. Reuse source u13m14st prior episode references across checkpoints 100k-500k; no new priors or shared-root banks. Actor, critic, and automatic-temperature update counts vary together.

inner_target_s512.description: J6/N512/H3/B512, inner_target bootstraps, one joint critic/actor/automatic-temperature update per 512 new imagined transitions: 3 after each full round, 18 per component per decision. Actor LR 5e-05; collection remains unfragmented.
